tiers.name: restricted
tiers.label: Restricted
tiers.purpose: Secrets and high-impact business data with strong legal or financial exposure.
examples: API tokens
agent/service-account credentials and one-time issued machine tokens
password hashes and auth signing keys
temporary default test credentials (for example admin/123456)
database credentials
HSCIQ API keys
DeepSeek API keys and encrypted deepseekApiKey system overrides
backend environment overrides containing real secrets
signed and system-generated legal/financial contract artifacts
generated shipment tax-refund confirmation checklists and material-version references
supplier bank account names, account numbers, branches, and bank routing codes
company bank statements, transaction identifiers, account balances, and even masked account identifiers when combined with transaction rows
carrier packing-list originals and persistent packing-list review records
email verification code hashes and Alibaba Cloud mail credentials
password reset code hashes, bound recovery email and persistent requester HMAC digests
opaque browser session credentials, SHA-256 session digests and session-bound CSRF proofs

storage: Secrets only in .env or secret manager

PR Review reporting uses zero GITHUB_TOKEN permissions and Actions summaries; failed check states are retained, and its locked formatter rejects incomplete history or unreadable changed source (scripts/check-pr-format.cjs)

Unchecked-login bearer tokens remain tab-scoped in sessionStorage; optional browser credentials are HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite=Strict cookies with existing absolute expiry and only hashed server-side; JavaScript holds only a session-bound CSRF proof
System-configured API keys are write-only; encrypted storage is permitted but complete values must never be returned or rendered
System configuration environment-key fallbacks use the same masked response helper as database keys
Main AI provider keys remain separate; DeepSeek environment/DB overrides are write-only and file permissions are checked before environment loading
AI Agent failures do not trigger nested transport/engine retries; existing request deadlines prevent repeated external prompt transfers
Restricted business records only in the application database or protected contract-evidence storage
Least privilege file mode (<=600 for backend .env)
Contract artifact and SQLite backup directories use 0700 and files use 0600
Legacy procurement attachment handlers reuse fileService permission enforcement and resolve downloads against UPLOAD_DIR

fileService.assertFileAccess shares existing ADMIN/FINANCE tax-confirmation access rules across generic and legacy purchase/sales download/delete routes; failed createFile writes clean only that request's new payload, never existing/generated attachments, and cleanup failures preserve the original error without logging paths; legacy purchase physical-archive retention is unchanged
Carrier packing-list raw extracted text is not persisted; structured check records retain their original file reference
HTTP request logs retain route, timing, and request shape only; request/query values, AI prompts, tool schemas, and user messages are excluded
HSCIQ upstream error bodies are excluded from service errors and logs; pending queries are bounded by a total timeout and quota reservation
AI provider calls bound full response waits, disable SDK automatic retry/logging and reuse streamed token usage without resending prompts for estimation

Customs draft replacement retains identity and is atomic; released records cannot be replaced. Shipment confirmation versions retain business facts and evidence while excluding technical createdAt/updatedAt timestamps

Agent normal and streaming requests explicitly use the local Anthropic protocol and the locked published SDK build without developer-local fallback; they inspect termination status, do not persist upstream errors as successful runs and do not automatically retry
Ordinary frontend requests and protected Next proxy downloads share API base parsing; bare origins gain /api/v1 while explicit API paths are retained without duplication
Purchase/inspection inventory cannot be manually transitioned through normal, bulk or AI endpoints; execution rechecks provenance and same-status requests preserve inventory timestamps
VPS runtime migration backups keep private environment files and SQLite snapshots in 0700 directories with 0600 files; deployment verification never prints process environments or credentials

Environment file permissions are checked before loading mail credentials; email registration uses keyed hashes, persistent send quotas and single-use verification; new users remain inactive until administrator approval; user updates clear authentication caches immediately (backend/src/services/emailRegistrationService.js)

Email password recovery uses domain-separated keyed hashes, persistent cross-worker quotas and atomic single-use consumption; live sessionVersion checks immediately revoke old JWTs after any password write; unknown/disabled/ambiguous/legacy-without-email accounts never bypass proof of ownership; raw Prisma query/error logging is disabled

Recovery HTTP rate limits use locked express-rate-limit and canonical IPv4-mapped/IPv6 subnet keys shared with persistent IP HMAC quotas; forwarded client identity requires an explicit TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS IP/CIDR allowlist, disabled by default; production database backup must follow the actual DATABASE_URL with consistent SQLite backup API and protected permissions before migration

browserSessionService.js enforces origin plus session-bound CSRF, live expiry/active/sessionVersion checks and per-browser revocation without global logout; auth responses are no-store, no renewal occurs, expired records are pruned at the next successful checked login, and revocation responses do not modify cookies

All HTTP auth and business routers pass the locked express-rate-limit global100/min gate before parsing; mapped IPv4 and IPv6 /56 keys are canonical, proxy trust remains explicit, and legacy429/Retry-After/reset headers plus stricter login10/15min remain compatible. Standalone auth test fixtures use the same real bound; CodeQL is neither suppressed nor bypassed. HTTP counters remain process-local and reset on restart; workers do not share counters. Existing persistent SQLite email/recovery quotas remain independent.
Operational verification notes, including ignored PLAN.md, record outcomes only and never real login credentials; redacting a note does not rotate credentials or prove Git history is clean
transfer: Do not paste into tickets/chat unless redacted
controls.retention: Rotate on role change; remove stale values within 24h of lifecycle end

tiers.name: confidential
tiers.label: Confidential
tiers.purpose: Business-sensitive internal data that is not publicly shareable.
examples: purchase contract and sales records
purchase batch arrivals, immutable inspection evidence, human operator references and inventory inspection provenance
historical procurement templates and their store/purchase details
supplier pricing and margins
financial summary reports, cash-flow statements, account balances, general-ledger entries, payroll, social-security, and tax-return structured rows
inventory and shipment operational history

storage: Restrict DB/service read access
Use role-based filtering at API response layer

backend/src/middleware/bossReadOnly.js permits BOSS explicit business GET/HEAD queries and own-password/notification-read exceptions only; authenticated database role overrides token claims and role changes invalidate caches
backend/src/controllers/financialStatementsController.js excludes account/ledger rows and source-file metadata before loading BOSS period summaries; evidence rows remain ADMIN/FINANCE only

backend/src/services/purchaseReceiptService.js atomically persists arrival/inspection evidence and accepted stock increments; routes/purchases.js requires human ADMIN/PURCHASE/WAREHOUSE, FIFO/rollback retain provenance, and historical data never gains fabricated evidence
Procurement-template reads require authentication at backend/src/routes/procurementTemplate.js before historical data is loaded
Monthly financial source files are parsed in memory; persist structured rows plus filename, size, and SHA-256 only
Financial evidence workbooks are never archived; sensitive personal identifiers are redacted before persistence and row-level reads require ADMIN or FINANCE
Shipment invoice-row preparations and exports require ADMIN/FINANCE; generated confirmation attachments keep the same download/delete restriction and use protected contract storage
Automatic internal draft creation in openAgentService.js retains per-tool roles and execution/replay records; physical, financial and configuration writes still require confirmation
Product navigation belongs to procurement at frontend/src/components/layout/navigation.config.ts; backend/src/routes/products.js remains the authority for read/write role checks
transfer: Mask identifiers in non-prod shared environments
controls.retention: Keep no longer than product/legal requirement; archive with access audit

tiers.name: internal
tiers.label: Internal
tiers.purpose: General internal information for team coordination and operation.
examples: planning docs
test fixtures
build scripts
readme and API contract docs
ByteRover engineering memory that excludes secrets and business-sensitive data

storage: Repository standard permissions
Code review for unintended leakage
controls.retention: Keep in repository history as needed and clean when obsolete
